_comment: Game-voice lines for the guild hall (Adventure only, so game words are fine). Every set is listed in docs/voice-lines.md beside its trigger and intended outcome. Placeholders are filled by the app: {building} {tier} {region} {boss} {month} {n} {chest}. The design rules apply: never shame, never blame or name a quiet partner, and losing the boss fight is never a punishment. hall_voice_test.dart guards the shape and the banned words; run check.sh after editing.
greetings: The hall lamps are lit. Every honest entry keeps them burning.
Smoke curls from the chimneys. The guild is open for business.
The banner snaps in the wind. Today's ledger awaits its scribe.
Hammers ring in the yard. Small entries build big halls.
A quiet morning in the hall. The scribe's quill is already inked.
The hearth is warm and the doors are open. Welcome back, adventurer.
Carts rattle through the gate. The guild grows a little every day you show up.
Lanterns glow over the plots. What will the hall become next?
noSpendDone: Nothing spent, and you said so. Today counts.
A quiet day on the books, honestly marked. The streak holds.
No coin left the pouch today. The scribe notes it with a nod.
Checked in. Showing up on a quiet day is still showing up.
Today is covered. Rest easy, adventurer.
A blank page, signed and dated. That is good bookkeeping.
The day is marked. The guild remembers who keeps the ledger honest.
Nothing to log, and you logged that. Well kept.
reconcileDone: The week is reconciled. The iron chest is on its way.
Every entry checked against the receipts. A tidy week.
Books balanced for the week. The quartermaster salutes you.
Reconciled. Nothing hides in this ledger.
The week's accounts are squared. Onward.
Checked, matched, done. That is a week well kept.
Another week settled with care. The guild grows stronger for it.
The scribe closes the week's pages with a satisfied stamp.
chestOpened: Treasure! The {chest} gives up its hoard.
You pry open the {chest}. A fine find.
The {chest} was heavier than it looked.
The guild gathers round as the {chest} opens.
rewardClaimed: A fine addition to the stores.
buildStarted: The builders get to work on the {building}.
The yard bustles: a {building} is going up.
upgradeStarted: The {building} is being raised to tier {tier}.
Builders swarm the {building}. Tier {tier} is coming.
New beams for the {building}: tier {tier} under way.
The {building} grows taller. Tier {tier} on the way.
Hammers ring at the {building}. Tier {tier} soon.
The {building} is getting a makeover to tier {tier}.
Fresh mortar for the {building}. Tier {tier} is near.
collected: The carts roll into the storehouse.
Fresh materials for the party pool.
The yard is cleared and the stores are fuller.
Collected. The {building} hums back to work.
expeditionSent: Boots laced, map folded: off to {region}.
A wave from the walls as the hero heads for {region}.
Pack full of rations, the hero marches toward {region}.
The road to {region} calls. The hero answers.
ritualStepDone: One more rune lit on the ritual circle.
Step done. The spoils draw closer.
The ritual hums a little brighter.
The circle glows. Onward to the next step.
The month's pages settle into place.
Done. The boss can sense you coming.
bossIntro: The ritual is complete. {boss} answers the call!
{boss} blocks the way to the spoils. Steel yourself!
A roar shakes the hall. It is {boss}!
The circle flares and {boss} steps through.
{boss} has come to test the guild.
Out of the season's storm strides {boss}.
bossTurns: A clash of steel and claw.
Gear gleams as the hero presses on.
A well-logged month lends the hero strength.
Sparks fly as the hero lands a hit.
bossWin: {boss} falls! A trophy for the mantel.
Victory! {boss} is felled and the spoils are yours.
The beast is down. The month is won.
A clean victory over {boss}. Glory to the guild.
The hall will sing of the fall of {boss}.
bossLoss: {boss} retreats into the mist. The spoils are yours all the same.
{boss} lives to fight another season, but the ritual is done and the chest is earned.
A hard fight. {boss} slips away, and the spoils chest arrives anyway.
{boss} withdraws, wounded. Your ritual earned the spoils regardless.
The beast escapes this time. The month's work still earns the spoils in full.
{boss} limps off. Better gear next month, and the chest is yours now.
No trophy today, but the ritual was the real victory. Open your chest.
{boss} holds the field for now. The spoils chest is already on its way.
spoilsChest: The spoils chest awaits in your inbox.
A spoils chest arrives at the hall.
The month's spoils are packed and delivered.
Your spoils chest is ready to open.
The quartermaster sets a spoils chest at your feet.
A spoils chest, earned by the ritual.
Spoils delivered. Go see what's inside.
The ritual's reward is waiting in the inbox.
caravan: The supply caravan keeps the party's stores stocked.
Supply carts roll in, courtesy of the caravan.
The caravan backs the party from the road.
Wagons of lumber and stone, sent by the caravan.
The caravan keeps the hall supplied.
The caravan's wheels never stop turning.
Fresh supplies from the caravan reach the yard.
The caravan is the backbone of the party's stores.

reasons.checkin.no_spend: Checked in on a quiet day
reasons.month.gold: Bonus: a budget finished on target
reasons.vault.consistency: Months of saving in a row

rejections.notEnoughGems: A few more gems needed. They come from logging, so every entry brings this closer.
rejections.notEnoughMaterials: The stores are a little short. Collect from your buildings or send the hero on an expedition.
rejections.invalidPlot: That plot isn't part of the hall.
rejections.buildingAlreadyInHall: The hall already has one of these. Each building gets one plot.
rejections.underConstruction: The builders are still at work. It'll be ready soon.
rejections.maxTierReached: This is already at its finest. Nothing left to add.
rejections.needsCentralHall: Raise the Central Hall first. It sets how high everything else can go.
rejections.nothingToCollect: Nothing ready yet. Check back in a little while.
rejections.storehouseFull: The Storehouse is full. Spend some materials or upgrade the Storehouse to make room.
rejections.unknownChest: That chest has already been opened.
rejections.catalogNotReady: The chest is still being unpacked. Give it a moment and try again.
rejections.unknownReward: That reward has already been claimed.
rejections.unknownGearType: That slot doesn't take that kind of gear.
rejections.needsForge: The Forge needs to be built or upgraded first.
rejections.invalidCustomization: Keep it short and not blank.
rejections.noChange: Your hero already looks like that.
rejections.regionLocked: This region opens as the Central Hall grows.
rejections.expeditionActive: The hero is already out on the road.
rejections.expeditionNotFinished: The hero is still travelling. Not long now.
rejections.ritualMonthNotClosed: The month isn't over yet. The ritual opens once it ends.
rejections.ritualMonthExpired: That month's ritual has closed. A fresh one opens every month.
rejections.ritualStepOutOfOrder: Take the steps in order. One at a time.
rejections.ritualIncomplete: Finish all four ritual steps to summon the boss.
rejections.bossAlreadyFought: This month's boss has already been faced.
rejections.ritualAlreadyFinished: This month's spoils are already home.
rejections.notInParty: Not in the party right now.
rejections.unknownItem: That item isn't in the catalogue.
rejections.notInShopToday: That one has left the shop. A new set arrives tomorrow.
rejections.itemNotOwned: You don't have a spare one of those yet. The shop or a chest might.
rejections.cellOccupied: Something's already there. Try a free spot.
rejections.outOfBounds: That doesn't quite fit there. Try a spot with a bit more room.
rejections.wrongSpace: That one belongs somewhere else. Rooms take furniture, the town takes garden pieces and statues.
rejections.unknownPlacement: That piece isn't on display any more.
rejections.notYourRoom: This is someone else's room. Yours is waiting for you.
rejections.notEquippable: Only outfits and titles can be worn.
rejections.starterAlreadyClaimed: Your starter set is already home.
